Name: Aimon's Tidy Cozy Farmhouse
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[size=2][b][center][font=Georgia][color=#fff2cc]Yet another FarmHouse remap mod.. this time more tidier and cozier!

[/color][/font]Updated for stardew 1.6 and should mostly work fine. Please chech the Bugs&Issues section before posting a bug in the comments.[/center][/b][center][/center][/size][url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/TTYyVRK/features.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*][size=2][b]Recolor[/b] - Vanilla, Rustic Country Town(dark), Rustic Country Town(white), Vibrant Pastoral, Starblue, Elegant[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Attic[/b] - it gets bigger with every farmhouse upgrade![/size]
[*][size=2][b]Balcony[/b] - smaller balcony for 1st farmhouse upgrade, bigger for 2nd![/size]
[*][size=2][b]Rooftop[/b] - outdoors location, it's appearance changed depending on season and weather![/size]
[*][size=2][b]Plant crops and trees in the balcony[/b] - just dig the floor with your hoe! [/size]
[*][size=2][b]Kitchen [/b]- enable\disable in config (enabled by default)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Hidden space at the bottom of the kitchen[/b] room for you to hide extra fridges! (see the screenshots)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Casks in farmhouse[/b] - enable\disable in config (enabled by default)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Crib Room [/b]- enable\disable in confing (disabled by default)[/size]
[*][size=2]Lightbeams in farmhouse and balcony - enable\disable in config (enabled by default, they will be visible any time except rainy days)[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Decorate every bit of wall your farmhouse have[/b] - long hallways for your paintings and attic beams for banners[/size]
[*][size=2][b]Enable\disable each farmhouse upgrade[/b] [b]redesign [/b]separately (if you upgraded your farmhouse up to cellar and want to use [b]Cabins as storage[/b] - just set "Farmhouse - Starter" option to "shed" or "off" in the config.[/size]
[/list]

[url=https://imgbb.com/]﻿﻿﻿[img]https://i.ibb.co/6YTbvZx/installation.png[/img][/url]

[list=1]
[*][size=2]Install all the required mods.[/size]
[*][size=2]Unpack the mod archive and place it into your Mods folder,[/size]
[*][size=2]Done!﻿﻿﻿[/size]
[/list][size=2]Note that for 1.5.6 stardew you also will need ExtraMapLayers mod.
[b][u]I also highly recommend to install  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Nocpil Mode[/url] - sometimes you'll need it to get out of buggy cutscenes and other stuff like that

[/u][/b][/size][size=3][u][color=#ffe599]HOW TO MAKE IT COMPATIBLE WITH OTHER FARMHOUSE MODS:
[/color][/u]
[list]
[*][size=3]For [b]Jen's Storage Cabins[/b] - enable Jen's Storage Cabins mod compatibility in my mod's config (optionally disable each farmhose upgrade you want to replace in my mod's config)[/size]
[*][size=3]For [b]other mods[/b] - disable every farmhouse upgrades in my mod's config which you want to replace.[/size]
[/list][b]NOTE that compatibility isn't guarrantied! It MIGHT BE buggy plus you probably will have lots of yellow errors in smapi log when you enter farmhouse and cabins (those errors won't crash your game) You also need to reload your game after editing my mod's config (so other mods can start loading their own farmhouse maps without smapi errors)[/b][/size]

[url=https://imgbb.com/][img]https://i.ibb.co/34knJbB/known-bugs-and-issues-faq.png[/img][/url]
[spoiler][b]VERY IMPORTANT![/b] If you used this mod and decided to deinstall it - pick up all your furniture and craftables from attic, balcony and rooftop rooms (because you won't be able to pick it up after deinstalling the mod.

[b]Stuck in a wall when starting new save [/b]- After starting new save file you will spawn in a wall stuck in bed. To get out of there - use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3900]Noclip Mode[/url] or temporary disable "Farmhouse - starter" in my mod's config to get out of the wall and then enable it again.
[b]
Furniture messed up[/b] - After starting new save file, upgrading farmhouse (or if you install this mod on already existing save) your furniture will be shifted and messed up.
Solution: you can pick up and relocate furniture after farmhouse upgrade, additionally use Noclip Mod if some of your funtiture got stuck in the void).

[b]No double bed after farmhouse upgrades[/b] - sometimes after you upgrade farmhouse, douple bed won't spawn - unfixable for now, just spawn it with CJB Item Spawner mod or buy one in Robin's shop.

[b]Multiplayer bugs[/b] - if 2nd player try to leave the cabin\go to attic - he will be teleported in main host farmhouse instead.
Solution: there's no really solution to that - cabin and farmhouse warps are hardcoded into the game. Additionally 2nd player could try disabling the farmhouse redesign in the config. Modded multiplayer experience can be buggy in general due to various hardcoded game mechanics - I can't really fix it fully in my mod.

[b]Black/empty spouse rooms [/b]- sometimes after applying patches from config your spouse room will go black.
Solution: save the game and reload your save file. Also you can try installing Farmhouse Fixes mod - it should help.

[b] Spouses WONT GO to attic and balcony[/b] - do not place your 1st double bed in attic or balcony, or spouses won't be able to sleep.
Solution: You absolutely need to place your FIRST double bed in the 1nd floor - spouses will sleep in this one bed.

[b]Rooftop door teleports to farmhouse entrance instead of attic [/b]
Solution: unfixable for now - such warps are hardcoded into the game.

[b]Pets and spouses wander\stuck in void.[/b]
Solution: they will automatically teleport pack on next day (or if not - use Noclip Mod for them to be able to escape the Void)

[b]Wallpaper overlap[/b] - in some places wallpapers will somewhat overlap at their highest point - made it on purpose, it's the only way 3 tile high wallpaper could work.
Solution: Use one toned wallpapers on those walls for bug being less visible.

[b]Robin's renovations[/b] - don't bother trying add farmhouse renovations from Robin's shop menu - they won't do anything because I deleted them. (Crib is working fine though, you can add or remove it with Robin's shop menu as usual)
[/spoiler]

[size=2]I know there's lots of issues so far but I tried hard to prevent even more, lol. There's a lot of nuances with farmhouse map I can't change due to it hardcoded into the game or other causes.[/size]
